title: Ownership file
description: Who owns each path of a repository and which files are generated. What depends on more than one file or on the repository - how declared paths relate, includes, the base of each file - is checked by `ownership validate`, not by this schema.

version.description: The schema version. This release supports 1.

plugins.description: Global configuration per plugin. Root file only. It links no path: only an entry of `owned` does.

basePath.description: A directory below the directory of this file; the paths of the file are relative to it. Ignored in the root file, whose base is the repository root.

owned.description: The owner of each path. Paths are disjoint: none repeats or contains another.

generated.description: Files produced by a command. Each one sits under an `owned` entry.

ignore.description: Paths left out of owner coverage.

include.description: Other ownership files to read: a file, or a directory (trailing `/`) that holds exactly one.

path.description: A literal path relative to the base of the file: no glob, no negation, no leading `/`. A trailing `/` means a directory.

filePath.description: A literal path of a file relative to the base of the file: no glob, no negation, no leading or trailing `/`.

pluginBlocks.description: Plugin name to block. The content of a block belongs to the plugin.

owner.description: A user or a team, as in CODEOWNERS: `@user` or `@org/team`.

skill.description: The skill that answers for the path.

plugins.description: The plugins this path belongs to. `name: {}` links the path without configuration.

command.description: Run at the repository root; what it prints must equal the file.
